description: Submit voice work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound.

inputSchema.description: Generate speech. Language and speaker names are case-sensitive. base requires authorized 2–30-second reference audio and its exact transcript; custom selects a named speaker; design describes a voice. Base may instead use reference_voice_id with automatic source transcript reuse.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_safety.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_voice_rights.description: MCP requires the user's voice rights acknowledgement in all Voice modes. For base mode, confirm authorization to reproduce the reference voice.

files.description: Optional upload parts (max 20 MiB total). Use audio for Voice, file for Edit/Upscale, image_upload/last_image_upload/voice_upload/music_upload for Video.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

instruction.description: Voice/tone instructions up to 1000 characters. Required for design, optional for Qwen custom speakers. Omit for base or fixed Korean speakers.

language.description: Use the full case-sensitive language name, e.g. Korean, not ko.

mode.description: base requires reference audio + exact transcript + voice rights. custom uses a named speaker; design uses instruction.

reference_text.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio, 1–4000 characters in base mode. Leave empty/omit in custom/design.

reference_voice_id.description: Base clone only: owned completed Voice result, or bind a preceding Voice output id. Mutually exclusive with uploads/inline audio. The server uses the source text as the exact reference transcript; omit reference_text or supply the same text. No download/re-upload is needed.

speaker.description: Required in custom mode. For Korean scripts up to 500 characters use zonos3-mini-seoyeon (서연, Zonos 3 Mini, automatic seed 1124) or voxcpm2-ko-host (VoxCPM2 한국어 여성 진행자). Both use a fixed delivery. Omit instruction and seed. Other named speakers use Qwen CustomVoice.

text.description: Text to speak, 1–2000 characters after trim and line-ending normalization.

uploads.description: Private uploaded file references from asset_upload or the web file library. No local paths, URLs or base64 in plans. Set the corresponding source/image/voice/music mode to upload.
